methodology.firstScrollBoundary: first scroll input issued by this harness after startup observation and readiness wait
methodology.webkitNetworkCaveat: Throttled WebKit uses buffered route fulfillment and is approximate; it is not equivalent to physical Safari streaming.
methodology.physicalDeviceBoundary: Playwright WebKit on Windows is not iPhone Safari, iPhone Chrome, Android Chrome, or macOS Safari acceptance.
